Publishing memo

Why this section is built this way

A compact rationale for the editorial, GEO, and localization choices behind TurboFlow Updates.

  1. First-party source of record

    An official Updates section gives search engines, AI systems, journalists, and partners one canonical page to cite.

  2. Structured facts are easier to quote

    Summaries and key-facts blocks expose entities, dates, and material details without forcing readers to infer them from prose.

  3. Citations strengthen trust

    Official and independent sources make each announcement verifiable and connect TurboFlow to consistent entity signals across the web.

  4. Separate language URLs improve discovery

    English and Chinese pages are independently indexable, connected with hreflang, and built from the same reviewed facts.

  5. Production deployment

    Deploy these generated files under tf.xyz/updates, merge the generated robots directives with the site-wide robots file, and include the Updates sitemap in the root sitemap index.
